feeds.title: Evidence & Policy Blog
feeds.description: Evidence & Policy is the first peer-reviewed journal dedicated to a comprehensive and critical assessment of the relationship between researchers and the evidence they produce and the concerns of policymakers and practitioners.

feeds.title: Urban Debate
feeds.description: NAUDL is the national leader in the urban debate movement, preparing the next generation to lead and succeed. Through debate, students learn critical thinking, communication, and collaboration skills. They also discover their passion for learning and become empowered to succeed in the classroom.

feeds.title: Rise & Shine Blog
feeds.description: We take debating from being an elitist, often cut-throat activity to something that is inclusive, playful, challenging, and experiential - working with each student to help them discover and hone their unique strengths and share their ideas with the world. Rise & Shine is about training the next generation of leaders, humanitarians, creators, thinkers, and people who are not afraid to stand up, speak out and let their talents shine!

feeds.title: Cogito Debate Blog
feeds.description: Cogito Debate is a WASC-accredited Speech and Debate School in Irvine, California. Cogito Debate offers a variety of courses tailored to elementary, middle, and high students that significantly help them become independent thinkers, strong speakers, and confident leaders through instruction in public speaking, parliamentary debate, and reading and writing.

feeds.title: BDL blog
feeds.description: We offer debate and argumentation programs for young people in Greater Boston, committed to serving students of color and other students who have been denied these educational opportunities. Our mission is to integrate argumentation and competitive debate into public schools in Boston to develop critical thinkers ready for college, careers, and engagement with the world around them.

feeds.title: Vancouver Debate Academy Blog
feeds.description: Vancouver Debate Academy is an internationally recognized private institution that offers debate and public speaking training to students from Grades 4 to 12 in Canada and abroad. Our skill-focused program improves students' public speaking, critical thinking, research, leadership, and teamwork skills and fosters intrinsic learning.

feeds.title: EUA-CDE
feeds.description: 'The Doctoral Debate' is an online platform featuring original articles with commentary and analysis on doctoral education in Europe. Articles focus on trending topics in doctoral education and state-of-the-art policies and practices. The Debate showcases the voices and views of EUA-CDE members and partners.

feeds.title: Ethos Debate Blog
feeds.description: Our champion-level debaters and experienced coaches compile sourcebooks, run camps, and help you to improve your skills in the arts of logic and rhetoric, honing your competitive edge. Ethos' mission is to foster wise decision-making in our culture by teaching critical thinking.

feeds.title: One Clap Speech and Debate Blog
feeds.description: At Speech and Debate Award Ceremonies across the nation, the One Clap Rule was established to expedite the process of awards. It is a way to show appreciation to students who earned a trip to the finals stage, but avoid long blocks of applause for dozens of students. The One Clap is both efficient AND infectious. It celebrates student success.

feeds.title: Wyoming Debate Roundup Blog
feeds.description: Wyoming Debate Roundup is dedicated to providing quality debate content to Wyoming and Rocky Mountain area high school debaters. We're a resource for Wyoming debaters by Wyoming debate coaches.

feeds.title: Debatetrack Blog
feeds.description: My name is Joel, and I made Debatetrack after coaching debate for 5 years with the goal to share the lectures, training, and materials I was making for my students. This is one of the best collections of Public Forum learning and teaching material available on the internet, including free lectures and cost-friendly briefs.

feeds.title: NIHD Blog
feeds.description: The National Institute for Homeschool Debate exists to provide professional-level coaching, camps, and casebooks that will equip students for the next level of success. NIHD operates on a unique, Christ-centered mission. We infuse a Christ-centered approach in everything we do, from our morning devotions to teaching each class from a Christian worldview.

feeds.title: Healthy Debate
feeds.description: Healthy Debate publishes journalism about health care in Canada by the people whose lives it touches the most, from physicians, patients, and caregivers to health journalists, academics, and advocates. Their unique focus on giving a platform to healthcare insiders allows them to provide detailed coverage of the inner workings and dysfunctions of this important sphere of Canadian society.

feeds.title: RIUDL Blog
feeds.description: We're a grassroots nonprofit supporting urban students and teachers through the power of debate. Our programs offer a comprehensive toolkit that puts urban students on a fast track to academic success, college and career readiness, and engaged citizenship.

feeds.title: The Debate Intensive
feeds.description: The country's top residential summer debate camp, featuring personalized instruction from the nation's very best coaches. Our philosophy is that the curriculum should always fit the students. Our instructors devote individual attention to each student which many camps reserve for top students to build their strengths and address their weaknesses.

feeds.title: US News » Debates
feeds.description: US News is a recognized leader in college, grad school, hospital, mutual fund, and car rankings. Track elected officials, research health conditions, and find news you can use in politics, business, health, and education. Read articles, news, and more on the topic of Debates in this segment of US News.
